name: dinomem retrieval log (native recall)
description: Captures NATIVE OpenClaw memory tools (memory_search / memory_get) into kb/retrieval_log/*.jsonl via an observation-only after_tool_call typed plugin hook. WHY: the dinomem retrieval_log was analyst-biased — only explicit python tools (hybrid_recall/session_search/...) logged, while other agents recall via NATIVE memory_search which was UNLOGGED, so recall metrics read as 0 for them. This plugin closes that gap so recall metrics are fair across all agents. It writes NOTHING itself: it shells out FIRE-AND-FORGET to procedures/_retrieval_log.py --record (the SAME writer the python tools use, single JSONL schema, source:"native"). Fully agent-agnostic: workspace is resolved from the hook runtime context / DINOMEM_WORKSPACE env, never a hardcoded id or path. Fail-OPEN in every branch — a logging miss must never slow or break the tool loop. Enable/disable via config.enabled or the DINOMEM_LOG_NATIVE_RECALL env.

enabled.description: Master switch. false = no-op (never logs). Env DINOMEM_LOG_NATIVE_RECALL=0 also disables.

agentFilter.description: Only log sessions whose sessionKey includes this substring. Empty string = all agents (installer-agnostic default).

nativeTools.description: Native OpenClaw memory tool names to capture. Default = the two base gateway memory tools; extend if a box exposes more native recall tools.

workspace.description: Explicit workspace root override. Empty = resolve dynamically (hook ctx cwd / DINOMEM_WORKSPACE / OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE / plugin dir walk-up). Set only if auto-resolution is wrong on an unusual layout.

python.description: Python interpreter used to invoke procedures/_retrieval_log.py --record.
